Great work requires great focus. Whether you're building the next big thing, writing your masterpiece, or mastering a skill, deep focus is your secret weapon. In this video, I’ll walk you through 5 science-backed steps to dramatically improve your daily focus—so you can get more done in less time and hit flow on command.

📍 Here’s what you’ll learn:

- How to find your biological peak focus windows
- A 2-minute writing ritual that primes your brain for deep work
- A simple eye trick that boosts attention-fueling neurochemicals
- Why short, urgent countdowns (aka “Goldilocks shot clocks”) increase flow
- How to break through mental fatigue with the “twice, then quit” method

These aren’t random tips—they’re sequential steps that work together to help you go deeper, stay focused longer, and produce exceptional results. Perfect for creators, entrepreneurs, students, and anyone serious about leveling up their productivity.

⏱ Try these steps during your next focus session and let me know how it goes in the comments.
